candidates.name: Papers.Demo.lem_schur
candidates.type: \label{lem:schur} For all real numbers $a, b, c \ge 0$, \[ a(a-b)(a-c) + b(b-a)(b-c) + c(c-a)(c-b) \ge 0 . \]

candidates.name: Papers.Demo.lem_sq
candidates.type: \label{lem:sq} For all real numbers $x$ and $y$, $x^2 + y^2 \ge 2xy$.

candidates.name: Papers.Demo.thm_amgm
candidates.type: For all real numbers $a, b \ge 0$, \[ \frac{a + b}{2} \ge \sqrt{ab} . \]

candidates.name: Papers.Demo.thm_cubic
candidates.type: \label{thm:cubic} For all real numbers $a, b, c \ge 0$, \[ (a + b + c)^3 + 9abc \ge 4(a + b + c)(ab + bc + ca) . \]
